title: gastrochilus compressus
intro: Gastrochilus compressus, commonly known as the Himalayan orchid or Compressus orchid, is a species of orchid native to the Himalayan region. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Gastrochilus compressus include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit potential anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of Gastrochilus compressus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
